question: What are the baselines used in the paper?

answer.free_form_answer: GloVe vectors trained on Wikipedia Corpus with ensembling, and GloVe vectors trained on Airbnb Data without ensembling

title: Using General Adversarial Networks for Marketing: A Case Study of Airbnb
answer_short: Adam optimizer, 16 LSTM units, 50-dimensional GloVe vectors, and a 70-30 split in train and test data.
answer_rationale: The baselines used in the paper are explicitly stated in the experiments section as: 'Common to all experiments was our decision to use an Adam optimizer, 16 LSTM units, 50-dimensional GloVe vectors, and a 70-30 split in train and test data.'
